{{Top}}
[[File:LobarAybock.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Two combatants shockboxing]]
'''Shockboxing''' was a violent and often dangerous sport where combatants fought each other in a ring using electrified [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]] known as [[shockmitt]]s. These [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] could deliver blows of varying levels of electrical intensity, from stun to more lethal levels. A popular training method amongst [[Army/Legends|military]] units, shockboxers were typically tough and skilled at Melee combat.<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> A regulation shockboxing match was divided up into ten equal two-and-a-half [[Standard minute/Legends|minute]] phases, with one-minute breaks between each phase.<ref name="FOI">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20081031.html|text="Fists of Ion"|int=Fists of Ion|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref> [[Barabel/Legends|Barabels]] were frequent participants and known to be exceptionally suited to the sport.<ref name="GaW" /> For several [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] title holder in shockboxing was the ferocious Barabel [[Tull Raine]].<ref name="FOI" />

[[Vycinyth]] and [[Reuss VIII/Legends|Reuss VIII]] both hosted shockboxing events.
